people.name: Ahasuerus
people.line: Persian Emperor (probably Xerxes I); husband of Esther

people.name: Bigthan
people.line: Persian official who plotted against King Ahasuerus

people.name: Mordecai
people.line: Esther's cousin, a Jewish leader in the Persian court.

people.name: Teresh
people.line: Persian official who plotted against King Ahasuerus

translations.web: In those days, while Mordecai was sitting in the king’s gate, two of the king’s eunuchs, Bigthan and Teresh, who were doorkeepers, were angry, and sought to lay hands on the King Ahasuerus.
translations.bsb: In those days, while Mordecai was sitting at the king’s gate, Bigthan and Teresh, two of the king’s eunuchs who guarded the entrance, grew angry and conspired to assassinate King Xerxes.
translations.kjv: In those days, while Mordecai sat in the king's gate, two of the king's chamberlains, Bigthan and Teresh, of those which kept the door, were wroth, and sought to lay hand on the king Ahasuerus.
translations.asv: In those days, while Mordecai was sitting in the king's gate, two of the king's chamberlains, Bigthan and Teresh, of those that kept the threshold, were wroth, and sought to lay hands on the king Ahasuerus.
